title: Aparihāni
text: 2. Satta vo bhikkhave aparihāniye dhamme desissāmi || taṃ suṇātha || || [page 086] 86 Bojjhaṅga-Saṃyuttam XLVI. 3. Katame ca bhikkhave satta aparihāniyā dhammā || yad idam satta bojjhaṅgā || katame satta || || Satisambojjhaṅgo || la-pe || upekhāsambojjhaṅgo || || Ime kho bhikkhave satta aparihāniyā dhammā ti || ||
